newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Chispa shares rally on talk of new offer.
newsitem.headline: Chile Chispa shares rally on talk of new offer.

text.p: Chilean Chispa investment stocks rallied midday on rumours that an investor may make a higher bid for its shares than that offered by Spanish utility Endesa, said traders.
Chispados was up 7.14 percent midsession at 180 pesos, while Almendros climbed 6.5 percent to 180 pesos.

The stocks climbed on a statement from a U.S financial agent calling itself Lawyers International Financial Enterprise Services offering to advise Chilean companies on how to make a stock swap to buy Chispa shares for more than the 220 pesos per share offered by Endesa.
Chilean brokers said many investors believed that a new offer may be made Monday for the stocks, which control power investment company Enersis .
"Many brokers phoned (the agent) in the United States and were told that a real offer will be made August 18 by a Chilean client," said one broker.
"But I'm waiting to see the offer before I believe it," he added, noting that the turnover in Chipsa stocks Thursday was relatively low.
Lawyers International Financial Enterprise Services was not immediately available for comment.
Endesa's offer to buy the Chispa stocks opens Monday and will be valid till August 30. (( -- Margaret Orgill, Santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595 x212))
